source_handle: 38 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Divide the gums, increase the gap, tighten and loosen them, remove them by pulling and pulling, and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
